scientific_integrity: The exact uniform baseline and its earlier publication are explicitly credited. Novelty of the nonuniform second coefficient is provisional and subject to broader literature priority review. Numerical and symbolic checks support but do not replace the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: For three independent identically distributed points on the unit sphere sampled from a strictly positive fixed \(C^2\) density. The asymptotic is epsilon to zero, the \(O(\varepsilon^6)\) coefficient uses the round metric, and the remainder is \(o(\varepsilon^6)\); no uniform error over density families, finite-epsilon formula for arbitrary densities, manifold generalization, or independent proof validation is asserted.
title: A two-term density-gradient law for rare three-point spherical cap clusters
